sections.heading: Hug a Mug Coffeehouse & Ceramics Studio

sections.bodyHtml: Comprehensive Branding for the woman-owned dark academia coffee shop of North Jersey. We worked extensively in visuals, branching our logo philosophy out to a merch line and videography focus for social media and menu design.

sections.heading: Hug a Mug went from Overlooked Local Spot to a Must-Visit Coffeehouse.
sections.bodyHtml:
One of few woman-owned coffee shops in Northern New Jersey, Hug a Mug Coffeehouse graced its town through lockdown, but lacked clear identity, strong customer recognition, and a cohesive visual system.

The original Canva-made logo wasn't rememberable, and didn't attract foot traffic.

Any photo/video evidence online wasn't as engaging as the actual shop itself.

sections.heading: Specialty Coffee and Homemade Syrups without a cohesive visual identity. Until now.
The Everyday Reminder of Homemade
sections.bodyHtml:
In the Late Internet Era, strong brands have strong social media presence. We showcased weekly specials and fan favorites as cinematic sighs of relief, stopping the algorithm scroll to remind customers that if they ever need a space to relax, we're there.

Monthly scripting, shooting, and scheduling of "stop the scroll"-technique video production.

Custom menu screens, cup stamps, and signage to enhance the customer experience.

sections.heading: One of the best hugs I've received was in Hug a Mug.
sections.bodyHtml:
The owner gave it to me on a Friday. It wasn't for any reason. She could just tell I needed it. "That's the kind of hug I give to my daughters," she said. If my 3 years of continued partnering with Hug a Mug can convey the right hug at the right time, then we've done the job well.

🏆 2023 NJ.com's "Top 43 Coffee Shops in New Jersey"

sections.text: The definition of an oversaturated market is "two guys with a podcast." 3 years later: Top 5 of Spotify & Apple's tabletop categories. 15,000 weekly listeners, and over 100 Patreon supporters. I was brought in first as the engine: creative producer for all things video, audio, and graphic.

sections.itemsHtml:
• Built a standout brand in a crowded genre. Named, designed, and launched a full visual identity that cut through the noise and earned long-term listener loyalty.
  • Directed post-production to shape pacing and punchlines. Edited every episode for clarity, tone, and humor—meeting Apple and Spotify standards.
  • Scaled to 15K weekly downloads and Top 5 on Spotify in under a year. Drove community support with 100+ Patreon backers and charity collabs with Bristol Royal Children's Hospital and Mythroll Armory.

sections.text: Visual Identity Overhaul for the Union, New Jersey powerlifting gym. We worked extensively in visuals, branching our logo philosophy out to a merch line and videography focus for social media and menu design.

sections.itemsHtml:
• Heavy collaboration with client to determine specific style and layout for Fall 2019, future apparel releases, and future Brand Identity.
  • Based on client needs, funneled ideas into 30 sketches, 10 preliminaries, and 2 revision finals.
  • Generated $3500 first-day revenue, with multiple colorways of the design still being released.
